name: md-commenter
description: Azure DevOps extension: comment on rendered Markdown in Pull Requests

scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.package:dev: npm run build:dev && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file overrides.dev.json --output-path out
scripts.publish: npm run build && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path out
scripts.publish:dev: npm run build:dev && tfx extension publish --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file overrides.dev.json --output-path out
